other_conditions: Applicant must be a marginal, small, or large farmer.
Farmers of all categories of landowners and forest lease holders are eligible.
Eligibility is limited to residents of Chhattisgarh state.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,000 per acre for paddy and maize, and ₹93.75 per quintal (maximum ₹355 per quintal) for sugarcane.
